turns.q: Is there a warranty or guarantee if something goes wrong?
How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks so much for reaching out! 😊

Orders typically leave our warehouse within 2 business days when they don’t include a pre-order or custom piece. After shipment:

Priority Shipping: 2 to 7 business days for domestic deliveries
US Express Delivery: 1 to 2 business days
International delivery: 15 to 20 business days

These are typical estimates, not guarantees. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time 💖
